Years ago I bought tickets for The Rolling Stones concert in Minneapolis and I got them from Stub Hub as Ticketmaster was playing their game where 90% of the tickets are automatically gone the second they go online for sale. Anyways time goes by & I had the tickets in my Apple wallet so thought everything was ok, then something came up & couldn’t attend the concert. I used Stub Hub to sell the tickets to someone else.

Night of the concert arrives & all of a sudden I’m getting  both emails & phone calls from Stub Hub saying the person who I sold the tickets too couldn’t get in because they were basically fake. I had to damn near argue with Stun Hub that I bought the tickets thru them so if they were no good then it goes back to the original seller and these tickets were like $180 each. I’m so glad I didn’t drive to Minneapolis only to get turned away, would have been livid,
